error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Use XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX.

init.title: Connection to the lamp
init.description: Lamps on the same Bluetooth proxy must all connect the same way.

data_description.connection: Stay connected: the lamp reports every change at once. Connect only when needed: Home Assistant connects for a change or a read and disconnects again, one lamp at a time.
data_description.poll_interval: Only when connecting when needed: minutes between two reads of the lamp's brightness, each over a short connection. 0 never reads it; the state is then what Home Assistant last set.
data_description.power_check_interval: Only when connecting when needed: seconds between two checks that the lamp still advertises, without a connection. A lamp that was not heard since the previous check has no power and turns unavailable. 0 leaves this to Home Assistant, which takes a few minutes.

command_failed.message: The lamp did not accept the command: {error}

name_too_long.message: The name takes {length} bytes in UTF-8; the lamp stores at most {max}.
